claims.text: Parent-child interaction — observe: does the child check back w the parent visually; does the child bring an object of interest to show or share w the parent; how does the parent react when you praise the child.
claims.quote: Does the child check back with the parent visually? • When the health care professional gives the child a book, does the parent follow the child's gaze? • Does the child bring an object of interest to show or share with the parent? • How does the parent react when the health care professional praises the child?
claims.locator: 12 Month Visit, Observation of Parent-Child Interaction
